# api

```go
import "github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/internal/api"
```

Package api is the HTTP front end: the AWS JSON 1.1 protocol for the secretsmanager service.

Requests: POST / with header X\-Amz\-Target: secretsmanager.\<Operation\> and a JSON body. Responses: 200 with a JSON body, or an error status with \{"\_\_type": \<code\>, "Message": \<msg\>\}.

## type [Authenticator](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/api/api.go#L87-L89>)

## type [Handler](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/api/api.go#L39>)

Handler implements one operation. It returns the output struct \(marshalled as JSON; nil → \{\}\) or an error \(\*apierr.Error for API errors; anything else → InternalServiceError\).

<a name="Identity"></a>
## type [Identity](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/api/api.go#L76-L83>)

Identity is who made the request, as far as the authenticator could tell.

```go
type Identity struct {
    AccessKeyID string
    // Region from the SigV4 credential scope ("" if unsigned).
    ScopeRegion string
    // UID is the local Unix user of the connection's peer, when segredium could determine
    // it (loopback TCP); nil otherwise. Used by server.access_mode=owner.
    UID *uint32
}
```

ParseCredentialScope extracts the access key id and region from a SigV4 Authorization header or X\-Amz\-Credential query parameter, without verifying anything.

<a name="ParseOnlyAuthenticator"></a>
## type [ParseOnlyAuthenticator](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/api/api.go#L98>)

ParseOnlyAuthenticator accepts every request and only extracts the access key and region from an Authorization header or presigned query, if present. It is auth.mode=none.

```go
type ParseOnlyAuthenticator struct{}
```
